The RangeFrom type is primarily used for implementing iterators that can iterate over a specific range of values. This article will delve into the history and background of the RangeFrom type in Rust, focusing on its implementation and evolution over time.

This is achieved through a fixed-point approximation of $\log_{10} 2$, precomputed power-of-10 tables, and the use of only one multiplication by a precomputed power of 10 in fixed-width integer arithmetic. The library's performance is comparable to that of classic Schubfach, but with a significant reduction in computational overhead.
